themes: Brazil's election outcome weakened the real, improving mills' export returns and triggering fund selling that pushed raw sugar to new lows early in the week.
Raws then consolidated on consumer and hedge-lifting buying without a real recovery, while London whites held up better, firming the white premium by the end of the week.
The US domestic market stays tight and insulated from the world slide because of a slow beet harvest, weaker Florida cane, reduced refining capacity and tariffs on Brazil.
On the demand side, GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are a slow structural drag concentrated in soft drinks, snacks and alcohol, with emerging-market uptake the long-run risk.

items.title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 6th November 2026
items.takeaway: Raws slipped back under steady selling while London whites held up, so the white premium firmed and the front white spread narrowed, a sign that refined sugar is relatively better supported than raw.

items.title: What Factors Influence Futures Market Spreads?
items.takeaway: A refreshed explainer: sugar spreads are set by crop seasonality, each exporter's own cost of carrying stock, the shape of the curve, physical premiums and the mechanics of expiries and index-fund rolls, which is useful framing for reading the current carry in No. 11.

items.title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 5th November 2026
items.takeaway: Speculative buying briefly lifted raws and whites off their lows but longs sold into the bounce, leaving the market consolidating rather than turning and the white premium little changed.

items.title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 4th November 2026
items.takeaway: Consumer buying and hedge lifting at lower prices steadied raws after the post-election drop, but with funds quiet there was no follow-through, which points to a floor being tested rather than a recovery.

items.title: US Sugar Remains Tight as Brazil Election Pressures Global Prices
items.takeaway: Lula's re-election weakened the real, which improves Brazilian export returns and pushed world raw futures lower, while the US domestic market stays firm on slow beet harvesting, weaker Florida cane, lost refining capacity and continued tariffs on Brazil.

items.title: The GLP-1 Effect Is Spreading
items.takeaway: Weight-loss drugs are cutting purchases of soft drinks, snacks and alcohol in rich markets and could reach big consumers like India, China and Brazil as generics get cheaper, a slow structural drag on sugar demand rather than a near-term price driver.

items.title: Daily Market Price Updates and Commentary 3rd November 2026
items.takeaway: Speculative longs liquidated after the Brazilian election, breaking raws through the previous week's low and gapping whites lower, with the commentary seeing technical weakness and only scale-down buying from consumers and multinationals underneath.
